# H - Debug & Reliability

## When to Use
- Diagnosing a broken pipeline stage
- Investigating regressions or performance issues
- Responding to an operational incident

## Procedure
1. Reproduce the failure and trace data flow.
2. Localize the affected stage and impact.
3. Test one hypothesis at a time.
4. Apply the minimal fix and verify stability.

## Standards
- Investigate root cause before proposing a fix.
- Verify the fix with evidence, not assumption.
